page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is an instance in the ecs.d1 family powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The server features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

A primary feature of this server configuration is its integrated local storage, offering 47,244 GB of magnetic hard disk drive (HDD) capacity. Network infrastructure connectivity is established with a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance does not include dedicated GPU hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The inclusion of high-capacity local HDD storage provides substantial volume density for large-scale data sets, though HDD latency presents a performance tradeoff compared to solid-state drives. Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio paired with extensive storage capacity, the ecs.d1.4xlarge is suited for big data processing, distributed file systems, log processing, and batch analytics storage workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a dedicated cloud instance provisioned with 16 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of memory, driven by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU operating at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture under the KVM hypervisor. Equipped with 4.0 GB of RAM per core and 6 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, its primary hardware differentiator is an integrated 47,244 GB local HDD array. This massive storage capacity offers high volume density for data-intensive applications, trading the higher random I/O throughput of SSDs for dense, cost-effective storage. Without GPU acceleration, the server focuses on compute and storage balance, making it suitable for distributed file systems, batch log analysis, data warehousing, and large-scale analytical processing workloads.
